prompt: Straight-on, top-down documentary photograph of a single printed A4 business letter lying flat on a light oak desk in an Indian home, used as the background for a 'demand letter' that the page overlays with real text in HTML. Everything else on the sheet is blank white paper. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no letterhead emblem or crest, no seals, no rubber stamps, no signatures, no QR codes, no watermarks, no hands, no pen, no other objects on the paper.
